meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

copy.tagline: 在 Emacs 中与 AI 对话，无需外部服务

copy.tagline_en: Chat with AI inside Emacs, no external service needed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Emacs and want to interact with AI directly from your editor

howto.what: 这个技能给 NanoClaw 增加一个 Emacs 聊天通道。装上后你能在 Emacs 里打开聊天窗口提问，也可以把 org 笔记里的内容发给助手，回复会作为子标题插回笔记里。
howto.when: 先按说明设置 EMACS_ENABLED=true 并配置好 Emacs 按键后；当你在 Emacs 里打开聊天缓冲发消息，或对 org 内容调用发送命令时触发。

say.text: 把这段笔记总结成三句话。
say.note: 先用发送命令把内容发出，回复会插回笔记。

say.text: 给选中的那段代码做代码审查。
say.note: 同上，走 org 发送，回复作为子标题。

howto.what_en: Adds Emacs as a channel for NanoClaw. After install you can chat from an Emacs buffer, or send org-mode content and get the reply inserted as a child heading.
howto.when_en: After you set EMACS_ENABLED=true and bind the keys, it triggers when you open the chat buffer and send a message, or run the org-send command on org content.

say_en.note: Sent to the chat buffer; reply shows in Emacs.

say_en.text: Summarize this note in three sentences.
say_en.note: Send the selected org content; reply is inserted as a child heading.
Uses org-send; the review lands as a subheading.
